comment: Slices of CoreCLR's src/tests on WitOS (plan step R7.2b), which @Docs/Implementation/R7.2b-CoreCLR-Tests.md explains. groups: upstream's merged test runners the guest runs whole, each in a process of its own. standalone: merged runners whose process-isolated tests the guest runs one by one, each in a process of its own, since a merged runner starts those through a script WitOS has no shell for. excluded: test names, as a group prints them or as the path of a process-isolated test's directory, with the reasons. Every other test must pass.

excluded.GC/API/GC/Collect_Optimized_2: reads Process.GetCurrentProcess(): System.Diagnostics.Process is unsupported on WitOS (RFC 0015 section 8)
excluded.GC/API/GC/Collect_Optimized_3: reads Process.GetCurrentProcess(): System.Diagnostics.Process is unsupported on WitOS (RFC 0015 section 8)
excluded.GC/API/NoGCRegion/Callback_Svr: needs the server GC through DOTNET_gcServer, which its script sets: one processor schedules threads until phase P
excluded.GC/API/NoGCRegion/NoGC: starts no-GC regions of 200 MB beside its heap, past the pages a process commits (256 MiB); the GC then faults freeing a handle (TableFreeSingleHandleToCache), an open question of the R7.2b document
excluded.GC/Coverage/LargeObjectAlloc: faults now and then in the same place as NoGC, freeing a handle (TableFreeSingleHandleToCache), and passes alone; an open question of the R7.2b document
excluded.GC/LargeMemory/API/gc/gettotalmemory: asks for 2 GB, since it reads the physical memory from /proc/meminfo, which WitOS does not have: on ARM64 the GC commits the process's whole page quota (256 MiB) before the allocation fails, and the runtime then has no memory to raise OutOfMemoryException
excluded.GC/Regressions/v2.0-beta2/460373/460373: keeps 500 MB live, past the pages a process commits (the system layer's quota, 256 MiB) and the guest's 512 MiB: the runtime ends on the out-of-memory exception
excluded.GC/Stress/Framework/ReliabilityFramework: writes its logs into its own directory, which is the read-only package
excluded.baseservices/exceptions/stackoverflow/st: starts a process: System.Diagnostics.Process is unsupported on WitOS (RFC 0015 section 8)
excluded.baseservices/exceptions/unhandled/unhand: starts a process: System.Diagnostics.Process is unsupported on WitOS (RFC 0015 section 8)
